newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Swedish woman murdered in Sri Lanka beach resort.
newsitem.headline: Swedish woman murdered in Sri Lanka beach resort.

text.p: A 74-year-old Swedish woman, who had been living in Sri Lanka for the past 20 years, was found murdered in her home at a beach resort close to the capital Colombo, police said on Monday.
Police said they discovered the naked body of Britta Graby in the bedroom of her house in Negombo town, 38 km (24 miles) north of Colombo late on Friday.
"No motive has been established for the murder yet. We are conducting investigations," D.M. Podimahatmaya of the Negombo police told Reuters.
Police said Graby was a shareholder of a tourist hotel in the area and also operated a guest house for foreign tourists.
